svg.text: Fairness depends on the entity and service unit
Independent serial and weighted references • all capacities funded • no overhead
Whole-request FIFO versus client rotation
A: eight units; B: four one-unit requests
FIFO terminals A8; B9,10,11,12 ms
Client turns A12; B2,4,6,8 ms
Per-request turns change the share
A,B1,B2,B3,B4 then A continues
B terminals 2,3,4,5; A terminal12 ms
Four requests do not imply four client shares
Equal request counts can hide unequal work
Two requests each; input/output charge1/2
A: 32 units; B: 8 units → 80% / 20%
Accounting cost is not fixed GPU time
Weights two to one: repeated A,A,B
Four rounds supply A8 / B4 units
Normalized received service: four each
Within-round difference: 0.5 → 1 → 0
FIFO and client rotation drain in twelve ms, but redistribute first-output and terminal delay.
Weighted endpoint equality alone proves neither equal waiting nor a short-window deadline.
